sceneFacts.shortVersion: Julia Roberts earned her first Oscar nomination for playing Shelby.
sceneFacts.longDescription: Julia Roberts earned her first Oscar nomination for playing Shelby. The role was based on screenwriter Robert Harling's sister, Susan.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Dolly Parton and Daryl Hannah went to beauty school for their roles.
sceneFacts.longDescription: Dolly Parton and Daryl Hannah went to beauty school for their roles. Parton even cut Julia Roberts' hair in a scene.

sceneAnchor.anchorElement: To convincingly portray their roles as salon owner Truvy and hairdresser Annelle, Dolly Parton and Daryl Hannah took professional hairdressing lessons.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Dolly Parton told the director: 'It's your job to make me look like I can act.'
sceneFacts.longDescription: Dolly Parton told the director: 'It's your job to make me look like I can act.' She said she was a personality hired for the movie, not an actress.

sceneAnchor.anchorElement: When director Herbert Ross questioned Dolly Parton's acting ability, she famously retorted, "No — but it's your job to make me look like I can."

sceneFacts.shortVersion: This armadillo cake revived red velvet's popularity.
sceneFacts.longDescription: This armadillo cake revived red velvet's popularity. It was inspired by a real cake at the screenwriter's sister's wedding.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: The film's writer, Robert Harling, plays the minister in this scene.
sceneFacts.longDescription: The film's writer, Robert Harling, plays the minister in this scene. He also wrote the screenplay for the movie.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: That festive background is Natchitoches' real Christmas Festival.
sceneFacts.longDescription: That festive background is Natchitoches' real Christmas Festival. The annual event features over 100 pieces twinkling with 300,000 lights.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: The title "Steel Magnolias" describes Southern women.
sceneFacts.longDescription: The title "Steel Magnolias" describes Southern women. It refers to those who appear delicate but possess unexpected strength.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: This film was shot in the writer's real hometown of Natchitoches.
sceneFacts.longDescription: This film was shot in the writer's real hometown of Natchitoches. Writer Robert Harling insisted on filming there to ensure authenticity.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Steel Magnolias was the first Western film with paid admission in East Germany.
sceneFacts.longDescription: Steel Magnolias was the first Western film with paid admission in East Germany. The line of East Berliners waiting to buy tickets stretched as far as the eye could see.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: The film's title was inspired by a neighbor's paperweight.
sceneFacts.longDescription: The film's title was inspired by a neighbor's paperweight. The object was called "the steel magnolia" by its owner.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: The score's soulful harmonica gives it a local touch.
sceneFacts.longDescription: The score's soulful harmonica gives it a local touch. This was a rare project that fit composer Georges Delerue's overtly emotional style.
